[01-08-2025 Navigating Blind Spots in Venture Capital with Jackson Scoresby In this episode of Leadership 3030, host Peter engages in a compelling conversation with Jackson Scoresby from Phoenix Ventures, focusing on blind spots within the venture capital industry. Jackson highlights inefficiencies in the finance function of early-stage B2B SaaS companies and discusses the benefits of integrating advanced tech solutions like large language models for accurate financial data processing. The discussion also explores the distinction between leadership and management, emphasizing the importance of vulnerability and humility in leadership amid the burgeoning AI landscape. Additionally, transformative technologies such as AI-driven tools for personalized marketing and the rise of agentic capabilities in AI are explored. [21-03-2025 Leadership Insights with Kevin David: Unpacking Customer Success and Future Leadership Traits In this episode of Leadership 3030, the host engages in a thought-provoking conversation with Mr. Kevin David. They delve into the often-overlooked topic of customer success, emphasizing its significance beyond mere revenue generation. Kevin shares his perspective on the true essence of leadership, contrasting it with management and underlining the importance of inspiration and motivation. They also touch on the transformative impact of modern communication technologies and discuss the timeless virtues of future leaders, drawing wisdom from civil rights icon John Lewis.
